# Quests reference

The quest log, quest givers and location markers, the quest, objective, reward and requirement assets, and the base classes for your own objectives, rewards and requirements. For how to use it, see [Quests](../modules/quests.md).

## VtUnitQuestLog

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Quests → VtUnitQuestLog**.

Per-unit quest log. Tracks active, complete, turned-in and failed quests for the holder, fans world events (kills, inventory changes, talks, location ticks) out to each active quest's objectives, runs time limits and repeat cooldowns, surfaces lifecycle events for your UI, and grants rewards on turn-in.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Location Tick Interval (`locationTickInterval`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between polls of reach-location objectives. 0.25 is responsive; raise it for very large logs. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyList<VtQuestProgress> Active { get; }` | Every quest in `VtQuestState.Active`, in accept order. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtQuestProgress> Completed { get; }` | Every quest in `VtQuestState.Complete`. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtQuestProgress> TurnedIn { get; }` | Every quest in `VtQuestState.TurnedIn`. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtQuestProgress> Failed { get; }` | Every quest in `VtQuestState.Failed`. |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition> OnQuestAccepted` | Fires after `Accept`, including a repeat or a retry. |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition> OnQuestAbandoned` | Fires after `Abandon`. |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition, VtQuestObjective, int, int> OnObjectiveProgressChanged` | Fires when an objective's progress changes: (quest, objective, old, new). |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition> OnQuestComplete` | Fires once when the last objective completes and the quest becomes `VtQuestState.Complete`. |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition> OnQuestTurnedIn` | Fires after a successful `TryTurnIn`; rewards are already granted. |
| `event Action<VtQuestDefinition> OnQuestFailed` | Fires when a quest fails: time limit expired, a protected unit died, or `Fail` was called. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings and subscribe to the world events. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `bool Accept(VtQuestDefinition quest)` | Accept `quest`: a new quest, a failed quest again, or a repeatable quest whose cooldown has passed. Progress starts from zero. Returns false when the quest is null or `IsAvailable` is false. |
| `bool Abandon(VtQuestDefinition quest)` | Drop an active, complete or failed quest. A quest that was turned in before reverts to `VtQuestState.TurnedIn` so prerequisites keep working; other entries are removed. Returns false when the quest is not in the log or is currently turned in. |
| `bool TryTurnIn(VtQuestDefinition quest)` | Turn in a complete quest: grants every reward, records the completion and starts the repeat cooldown. Returns false when the quest is not complete. |
| `bool Fail(VtQuestDefinition quest)` | Fail an active or complete quest. Returns false when it is not in one of those states. Time limits and protected-unit deaths call this internally. |
| `bool ResetRepeat(VtQuestDefinition quest)` | Clear the repeat cooldown of a turned-in repeatable quest so it can be accepted right away. Call it from your daily or weekly reset. |
| `bool IsActive(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True while `q` is `VtQuestState.Active`. |
| `bool IsCompleteAndUnclaimed(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True while `q` is `VtQuestState.Complete`. |
| `bool IsTurnedIn(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True while `q` is `VtQuestState.TurnedIn`. |
| `bool IsFailed(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True while `q` is `VtQuestState.Failed`. |
| `bool HasEverTurnedIn(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True when `q` has been turned in at least once, whatever its state is now. Prerequisites use this, so a repeatable quest that is active again still unlocks its chain. |
| `float GetSecondsRemaining(VtQuestDefinition q)` | Seconds left on the time limit of an active quest, 0 otherwise. |
| `float GetRepeatCooldownRemaining(VtQuestDefinition q)` | Seconds until a turned-in repeatable quest can be accepted again, 0 when ready. |
| `bool IsAvailable(VtQuestDefinition q)` | True when `q` can be accepted now: not in progress, level and prerequisite quests met, not excluded by a branch already taken, every `VtQuestDefinition.requirements` entry met, and, for a failed or repeatable quest, ready to be taken again. |
| `int GetProgress(VtQuestDefinition quest, VtQuestObjective objective)` | Progress on `objective` within `quest`, 0 when unknown. |
| `void ApplyQuestLogFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtQuestProgress> snapshot)` | Replace every entry with an authoritative snapshot. Bypasses the authority gate. Fires the lifecycle events only for entries that actually changed. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance time limits, repeat cooldowns and the reach-location poll by `deltaTime` seconds. Authority-only. |

## VtQuestGiver

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Quests → VtQuestGiver**.

Put it on an NPC that offers quests, that talk objectives point at, or both. Players reach it through the normal right-click, walk-to and interact flow, with no extra input wiring.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offered Quests (`offeredQuests`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Quests this NPC offers. Empty = NPC is a pure talk-target (satisfies talk objectives but doesn't surface quests). Non-empty = consumer UI should render an offer dialog when OnQuestOffered fires. |
| Interact Radius (`interactRadius`) | `float` | 2.5 | ≥ 0 | Distance (world units) within which the player can interact with this NPC. The walk-to-pickup flow stops here. |
| Dialogue (`dialogue`) | [VtDialogueDefinition](dialogue.md#vtdialoguedefinition) | None |  | Conversation run on the player's VtUnitDialogue when they interact. Empty = the greeting is shown with the offered quests as answers. |
| Greeting (`greeting`) | `string` | Empty |  | Line shown when there is no dialogue asset. Empty with nothing to offer = no conversation opens. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<VtUnit, VtQuestDefinition[]> OnQuestOffered` | Fires when a player successfully interacts with this NPC. Args: (player, offeredQuests). Non-null player; offeredQuests may be empty (pure talk-target NPCs). Consumer UI subscribes to render the offer dialog and calls `VtUnitQuestLog.Accept` on the player's log when confirmed. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the sibling `VtUnit`. Idempotent — safe to call any number of times. Call it after adding the component from code. |

## VtQuestLocationMarker

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Quests → VtQuestLocationMarker**.

Scene-placed marker that names a world location for `VtReachLocationObjective` to look up by id. Drop one of these onto an empty GameObject at the destination, set `locationId` to a stable string ("village_square", "mage_tower", "treasure_chest_1"), and any quest with a reach-location objective referencing that id will trigger when the holder walks within range.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Location Id (`locationId`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string id the reach-location objective references. Convention: lowercase_snake_case. Required. |
| Gizmo Color (`gizmoColor`) | `Color` | `#FFFF0080` |  | Color of the editor gizmo wire sphere drawn when this marker is selected. Helps authors locate quest waypoints in busy scenes. |
| Gizmo Radius (`gizmoRadius`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0.5 | Wire-sphere radius (editor only — gizmos). Set this to roughly match your quest objectives' arriveRadius for a useful preview. Has no runtime effect; the actual completion radius is per-objective. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtQuestLocationMarker Find(string locationId)` | Look up the registered marker for `locationId`. Returns null if no marker is currently active for that id (the scene holding the marker isn't loaded, the marker GameObject is disabled, or the id was never registered). Reach-location objectives use this on every tick. |
| `void Register()` | Register (or re-register) this marker under its current `locationId`. Idempotent — safe to call any number of times. Call it after setting `locationId` from code, because `OnEnable` runs before the field is set. |

## VtQuestDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Quest Definition**.

Authored quest: identity, category, objectives, rewards, prerequisites, requirements, repeat rules and fail conditions. `VtUnitQuestLog` drives the lifecycle.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for save files and network payloads. Convention: 'quest.<area>.<name>'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown in the quest log and the giver dialog. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Quest text shown in the giver dialog and the quest log. |

#### Classification

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Category (`category`) | [VtQuestCategoryDefinition](#vtquestcategorydefinition) | None |  | Category for UI sorting and tinting. Optional. |

#### Objectives & Rewards

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Objectives (`objectives`) | [VtQuestObjective](#vtquestobjective)[] | Empty |  | Objectives in display order. The quest completes when every one reports IsComplete. |
| Rewards (`rewards`) | [VtQuestReward](#vtquestreward)[] | Empty |  | Rewards granted on turn-in, in array order. |

#### Prerequisites

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Level (`requiredLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum holder level to accept. 0 = no gate. Units without a level component count as level 1. |
| Required Completed Quests (`requiredCompletedQuests`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Every one of these must have been turned in before this quest is offered. Empty = no requirement. |
| Required Any Of Quests (`requiredAnyOfQuests`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition)[] | Empty |  | At least one of these must have been turned in. Empty = no requirement. Combine with Required Completed Quests for 'A and (B or C)'. |
| Excluded By Quests (`excludedByQuests`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Once any of these has been turned in this quest is never offered. Use it for branches where choosing one path closes the other. |
| Requirements (`requirements`) | [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement)[] | Empty |  | Extra conditions on the holder, all of which must pass: items carried, currency, a stat threshold, a unit tag, faction, or your own subclass. Empty = no requirement. |

#### Repeat

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeatable (`repeatable`) | `bool` | Off |  | Can be accepted again after it has been turned in. Progress starts over; the turn-in count is kept for prerequisites. |
| Repeat Cooldown Seconds (`repeatCooldownSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds after turn-in before a repeatable quest is offered again. 0 = immediately. Counts in simulation time. For a daily reset, call VtUnitQuestLog.ResetRepeat at your reset moment instead. |

#### Failure

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time Limit Seconds (`timeLimitSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds the holder has to finish the objectives after accepting. 0 = no limit. The timer stops once the quest is complete; it fails if it runs out while still active. |
| Fail When Tagged Unit Dies (`failWhenTaggedUnitDies`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition) | None |  | The quest fails when any unit carrying this tag dies while the quest is active. Tag the escortee or the caravan and leave everything else untagged. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `Vector2 graphPosition` | Where the quest sits in the Quest Graph window. Editor layout only; the quest log ignores it. |

## VtQuestCategoryDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Quest Category**.

Authored quest category — Main / Side / Daily / Weekly etc. Each `VtQuestDefinition` references one category; the category drives UI sort order, tinting, and any consumer-side feature gating (e.g. "show daily quests in a separate tab"). Asset-per-tier and consumer-extensible — same shape as `VtItemRarityDefinition`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'category.main', 'category.daily'. Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | UI display name. E.g. 'Main Story', 'Side', 'Daily'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty | Designer-facing description. Doesn't affect runtime. |
| Sort Weight (`sortWeight`) | `int` | 0 | Sort priority for quest-log UI ordering. Lower = appears first. Convention: Main 0, Side 100, Daily 200, Weekly 300. Leave gaps for inserts (e.g. 'Heroic 50' between Main and Side). |
| Color (`color`) | `Color` | `#FFFFFFFF` | UI tint applied to the quest's name / category label in the log. Default Vantage palette: Main = gold, Side = white, Daily = blue, Weekly = purple. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None | Optional icon shown next to the quest in the log / on the quest-giver indicator. Null for no icon — consumer UI then renders just the tint. |

## VtKillObjective

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Objectives → Kill**. Inherits [VtQuestObjective](#vtquestobjective).

"Kill N units of type X" objective. Matches the killed unit by tag (`targetTag`) or by direct definition reference (`targetDefinition`). Both filters are optional and ANDed when both set; if both are null, the objective counts every kill in the world (rarely useful — but lets consumers ship "Kill 1000 of anything" achievement-style quests).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI text shown in the quest log entry. E.g. 'Slay 5 wolves', 'Collect 10 bluebells', 'Talk to the Elder'. Render in your consumer-side log UI; the library doesn't render it itself. |
| Required Count (`requiredCount`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Threshold the progress counter must hit for this objective to be Complete. Kill / collect objectives use this as 'kill N' / 'have N in inventory'; binary objectives (talk / reach) ignore values > 1 unless the subclass overrides for distinct-N semantics. |
| Target Tag (`targetTag`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, only kills of units carrying this tag count. Pair with VtUnitDefinition.tags. Leave null to skip the tag filter. |
| Target Definition (`targetDefinition`) | [VtUnitDefinition](units.md#vtunitdefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, only kills of units with this exact definition asset count. Useful for boss-specific quests. Leave null to skip the definition filter. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override int OnUnitDied(VtUnit killed, VtUnitId killer, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Adds one to the progress when the holder, its summon or a party member sharing credit killed a unit that matches `targetTag` and `targetDefinition`. |

## VtCollectObjective

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Objectives → Collect**. Inherits [VtQuestObjective](#vtquestobjective).

"Have N of item X in your inventory" objective. Reads `VtUnitInventory.GetCount` on every inventory change and sets progress to the current stack count (capped at `VtQuestObjective.requiredCount`).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI text shown in the quest log entry. E.g. 'Slay 5 wolves', 'Collect 10 bluebells', 'Talk to the Elder'. Render in your consumer-side log UI; the library doesn't render it itself. |
| Required Count (`requiredCount`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Threshold the progress counter must hit for this objective to be Complete. Kill / collect objectives use this as 'kill N' / 'have N in inventory'; binary objectives (talk / reach) ignore values > 1 unless the subclass overrides for distinct-N semantics. |
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item to count in the holder's inventory. Required — objective is silently skipped if null. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override int OnInventoryChange(VtUnitInventory inv, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Sets the progress to how many of `item` the holder carries now, capped at the required count. |

## VtTalkObjective

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Objectives → Talk**. Inherits [VtQuestObjective](#vtquestobjective).

"Talk to NPC matching X" objective. Triggers when the holder interacts with any `VtQuestGiver` whose unit matches `targetTag` and/or `targetDefinition`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI text shown in the quest log entry. E.g. 'Slay 5 wolves', 'Collect 10 bluebells', 'Talk to the Elder'. Render in your consumer-side log UI; the library doesn't render it itself. |
| Required Count (`requiredCount`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Threshold the progress counter must hit for this objective to be Complete. Kill / collect objectives use this as 'kill N' / 'have N in inventory'; binary objectives (talk / reach) ignore values > 1 unless the subclass overrides for distinct-N semantics. |
| Target Tag (`targetTag`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, only NPCs carrying this tag count. Pair with VtUnitDefinition.tags to mark 'Elder', 'Merchant', 'QuestGiver' etc. Leave null to skip the tag filter. |
| Target Definition (`targetDefinition`) | [VtUnitDefinition](units.md#vtunitdefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, only the NPC with this exact definition asset counts. Useful for 'Talk to Elder Brennan' specifically. Leave null to skip the definition filter. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override int OnTalked(VtUnit npc, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Adds one to the progress when the holder talks to an NPC that `Matches`. |
| `bool Matches(VtUnit npc)` | True when talking to `npc` counts for this objective: it carries `targetTag` and uses `targetDefinition`, where those are set. |

## VtReachLocationObjective

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Objectives → Reach Location**. Inherits [VtQuestObjective](#vtquestobjective).

"Reach a named world location" objective. Pairs with a `VtQuestLocationMarker` placed in the scene at the destination — the marker's `VtQuestLocationMarker.locationId` must match `locationId`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI text shown in the quest log entry. E.g. 'Slay 5 wolves', 'Collect 10 bluebells', 'Talk to the Elder'. Render in your consumer-side log UI; the library doesn't render it itself. |
| Required Count (`requiredCount`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Threshold the progress counter must hit for this objective to be Complete. Kill / collect objectives use this as 'kill N' / 'have N in inventory'; binary objectives (talk / reach) ignore values > 1 unless the subclass overrides for distinct-N semantics. |
| Location Id (`locationId`) | `string` | Empty |  | String id matching a VtQuestLocationMarker.locationId in the scene. The marker's transform is the destination. Required — objective silently no-ops if no marker is registered for this id. |
| Arrive Radius (`arriveRadius`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0.5 | Distance (XZ-plane, world units) the holder must be within to trigger completion. 2 = standard 'walk into the spot' feel; larger for vague 'enter the village' objectives. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override int OnLocationTick(VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Completes the objective once the holder stands within `arriveRadius` of the marker named `locationId`. |

## VtItemQuestReward

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Rewards → Item**. Inherits [VtQuestReward](#vtquestreward).

Quest reward: grant N copies of an item to the recipient's inventory. No-ops gracefully if the recipient lacks a `VtUnitInventory` component (e.g. a non-player unit accidentally turning in a quest).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item granted on turn-in. Required — reward silently no-ops if null. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Number of copies granted. Stackable items merge into one inventory entry; non-stackable items each occupy a separate slot. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override void Grant(VtUnit recipient)` | Adds `count` copies of `item` to the recipient's inventory. Does nothing without an inventory; copies that do not fit are lost. |

## VtCurrencyQuestReward

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Rewards → Currency**. Inherits [VtQuestReward](#vtquestreward).

Quest reward: credit a currency amount to the recipient's wallet. No-ops gracefully if the recipient lacks a `VtUnitWallet` component.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Currency (`currency`) | [VtCurrencyDefinition](currency.md#vtcurrencydefinition) | None |  | Currency type credited on turn-in. Required — reward silently no-ops if null. |
| Amount (`amount`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Amount credited. Negative or zero values no-op (use the wallet API directly if you need to subtract). |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override void Grant(VtUnit recipient)` | Adds `amount` of `currency` to the recipient's wallet. Does nothing without a wallet. |

## VtXpQuestReward

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Rewards → XP**. Inherits [VtQuestReward](#vtquestreward).

Quest reward: credit XP to the recipient's `VtUnitLevel`. No-ops gracefully if the recipient lacks the level component (which is the typical case for non-leveling units like merchants or pets).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Xp (`xp`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | XP credited on turn-in. Negative or zero values no-op. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override void Grant(VtUnit recipient)` | Credits `xp` to the recipient's `VtUnitLevel`, scaled by its XP gain bonus. Does nothing on a unit that does not level. |

## VtItemQuestRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Item**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Quest requirement: the holder carries at least `count` of `item` in its `VtUnitInventory`. A holder without an inventory never meets it. The items are not consumed; pair with a collect objective if the quest should take them.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item the holder must carry. Required; a null item never passes. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Minimum stack count across the whole inventory. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the holder's inventory holds at least `count` of `item`. |

## VtCurrencyQuestRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Currency**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Quest requirement: the holder's `VtUnitWallet` holds at least `amount` of `currency`. A holder without a wallet never meets it. Nothing is deducted.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Currency (`currency`) | [VtCurrencyDefinition](currency.md#vtcurrencydefinition) | None |  | Currency to check. Required; a null currency never passes. |
| Amount (`amount`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Minimum balance. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the holder's wallet holds at least `amount` of `currency`. |

## VtStatQuestRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Stat**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Quest requirement: the holder's resolved value for `stat` is at least `minimum`. Reads the aggregated stat, so equipment, buffs and attribute formulas all count. Use it for gates such as "Armor 50 or more" or a consumer-authored reputation stat.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stat (`stat`) | [VtStatDefinition](units.md#vtstatdefinition) | None | Stat to compare. Required; a null stat never passes. |
| Minimum (`minimum`) | `float` | 1 | The holder's resolved stat value must be at least this. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the holder's resolved `stat` is at least `minimum`. |

## VtUnitTagQuestRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Unit Tag**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Quest requirement: the holder carries `tag` on its unit definition. Use it for class or race gates such as "Mage only" when those are modelled as unit tags. Check `invert` to require that the tag is absent instead.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tag (`tag`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition) | None | Tag the holder must carry. Required; a null tag never passes. |
| Invert (`invert`) | `bool` | Off | When checked the holder must NOT carry the tag. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the holder carries `tag`, or lacks it when `invert` is checked. |

## VtFactionQuestRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Faction**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Quest requirement: the holder belongs to one of `factions`. Use it so an NPC offers different quests to different sides.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Factions (`factions`) | [VtFaction](#vtfaction)[] | Empty | The holder's faction must be one of these. Empty never passes. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the holder's current faction is one of `factions`. |

## VtQuestStateRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Quest State**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](#vtquestrequirement).

Requirement: a quest is in a given state on the holder's `VtUnitQuestLog`. Use it to show a dialogue answer only while a quest is active, or a turn-in answer only once it is complete. A holder without a quest log never meets it.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quest (`quest`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition) | None | Quest to check. Required; a null quest never passes. |
| State (`state`) | [VtQuestState](#vtqueststate) | `Complete` | State the quest must be in. Available means it could be accepted right now. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when `quest` is in `state` on the holder's quest log. |

## VtQuestProgress

Serializable struct.

Per-quest state held in a `VtUnitQuestLog`: one entry per quest the holder has accepted at some point.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quest (`Quest`) | [VtQuestDefinition](#vtquestdefinition) | None | The quest this entry tracks. Null entries are ignored. |
| State (`State`) | [VtQuestState](#vtqueststate) | `Available` | Lifecycle state of the quest in the log. |
| Objective Progress (`ObjectiveProgress`) | `int`[] | Empty | Progress counter per objective, in the same order as the quest's objectives. |
| Seconds Remaining (`SecondsRemaining`) | `float` | 0 | Seconds left on the time limit while the quest is active. 0 when the quest has no limit. |
| Times Turned In (`TimesTurnedIn`) | `int` | 0 | How many times the quest has been turned in. Prerequisites read this. |
| Repeat Cooldown Remaining (`RepeatCooldownRemaining`) | `float` | 0 | Seconds until a repeatable quest can be accepted again. 0 when ready. |

## VtQuestObjective

Abstract asset base. Shipped subclasses: [VtCollectObjective](#vtcollectobjective), [VtKillObjective](#vtkillobjective), [VtReachLocationObjective](#vtreachlocationobjective), [VtTalkObjective](#vttalkobjective).

Abstract authored quest objective. Subclass to ship a new objective type; the four built-ins (`VtKillObjective`, `VtCollectObjective`, `VtReachLocationObjective`, `VtTalkObjective`) cover ~80% of MMO/ARPG quests, and consumer-authored subclasses ship a new file with one virtual override each (escort, defend, time-limited, deliver, etc.).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Description (`description`) | `string` |  | UI text shown in the quest log entry. E.g. 'Slay 5 wolves', 'Collect 10 bluebells', 'Talk to the Elder'. Render in your consumer-side log UI; the library doesn't render it itself. |
| Required Count (`requiredCount`) | `int` | ≥ 1 | Threshold the progress counter must hit for this objective to be Complete. Kill / collect objectives use this as 'kill N' / 'have N in inventory'; binary objectives (talk / reach) ignore values > 1 unless the subclass overrides for distinct-N semantics. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsComplete(int progress)` | True when `progress` meets or exceeds `requiredCount`. The log uses this to decide quest completion; subclasses should not override unless they're encoding non-monotonic progress (rare). |
| `virtual int OnUnitDied(VtUnit killed, VtUnitId killer, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Hook fired when any unit dies in the world (via `VtUnitStats.OnAnyUnitDied`). Default no-op; kill objectives override. |
| `virtual int OnInventoryChange(VtUnitInventory inv, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Hook fired when the holder's `VtUnitInventory` changes (via `VtUnitInventory.OnInventoryChanged`). Default no-op; collect objectives override. |
| `virtual int OnTalked(VtUnit npc, VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Hook fired when the holder talks to a quest-giver / talkable NPC (via `VtQuestEvents.OnTalked`). Default no-op; talk objectives override. |
| `virtual int OnLocationTick(VtUnit holder, int currentProgress)` | Hook fired on the quest log's per-tick coroutine (~4Hz by default). Default no-op; reach-location objectives override to poll distance to a `VtQuestLocationMarker`. |

## VtQuestReward

Abstract asset base. Shipped subclasses: [VtCurrencyQuestReward](#vtcurrencyquestreward), [VtItemQuestReward](#vtitemquestreward), [VtXpQuestReward](#vtxpquestreward).

Abstract authored quest reward. Subclass to ship a new reward type; the three built-ins (`VtItemQuestReward`, `VtCurrencyQuestReward`, `VtXpQuestReward`) cover the standard MMO/ARPG turn-in payoff. Consumer-extensible — a "grant a buff" or "unlock a recipe" reward is one file with a `Grant` override.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `abstract void Grant(VtUnit recipient)` | Apply the reward to `recipient` (the unit whose `VtUnitQuestLog` is turning in the quest). Authority-gated by the underlying systems (wallet / inventory / level already gate); the reward itself doesn't need to re-check. |

## VtQuestRequirement

Abstract asset base. Shipped subclasses: [VtCurrencyQuestRequirement](#vtcurrencyquestrequirement), [VtDialogueFlagRequirement](dialogue.md#vtdialogueflagrequirement), [VtFactionQuestRequirement](#vtfactionquestrequirement), [VtItemQuestRequirement](#vtitemquestrequirement), [VtQuestStateRequirement](#vtqueststaterequirement), [VtStatQuestRequirement](#vtstatquestrequirement), [VtTimeOfDayRequirement](world-time.md#vttimeofdayrequirement), [VtUnitTagQuestRequirement](#vtunittagquestrequirement).

Abstract authored condition a unit must satisfy before a quest is offered to it. Subclass to ship a new gate; the built-ins cover items in the backpack (`VtItemQuestRequirement`), currency (`VtCurrencyQuestRequirement`), a stat threshold (`VtStatQuestRequirement`), a unit tag (`VtUnitTagQuestRequirement`) and faction (`VtFactionQuestRequirement`). A reputation, class or custom-flag gate is one file with an `IsMet` override.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `abstract bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when `holder` satisfies this condition right now. Called with a non-null holder; return false for anything that cannot be verified. |

## VtQuestEvents

Static class.

Static event hub for the quest system. One global subscription point per signal that needs world-wide reach without forcing every quest log to subscribe to every potential producer.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static event Action<VtUnit, VtUnit> OnTalked` | Fired when a player interacts with a `VtQuestGiver`. Args: (npc, player). Both args are non-null. Talk objectives advance from it; your UI may also subscribe to render quest-offer dialogs. |
| `static void RaiseTalked(VtUnit npc, VtUnit player)` | Raise `OnTalked`. `VtQuestGiver` does this on interact; call it yourself only from a custom talk interaction. |

## Enums

### VtFaction

Team or allegiance of a `VtUnit`. Units of different factions fight each other unless either is Neutral; AI targeting, splash damage and projectiles all respect it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Neutral` | Unaffiliated or ambient — not targeted, not hostile. |
| `Player` | The local player and their summons / pets. |
| `Enemy` | Scripted hostile units (waves, bosses). |
| `Wildlife` | Passive NPCs (deer, rabbits) — flee when attacked, don't aggro. |

### VtQuestState

Lifecycle state of a single quest in a `VtUnitQuestLog`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Available` | Not in the log and every prerequisite is met. Computed only. |
| `Active` | Accepted; objectives in progress. |
| `Complete` | Every objective satisfied; rewards not yet granted. |
| `TurnedIn` | Rewards granted. Counts for prerequisites; repeatable quests can be accepted again from here. |
| `Failed` | Time ran out or a fail condition triggered. Can be accepted again. |
